DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込画面で操作が止まっていますね。暗証番号以外で、ご不明な点をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have stopped on the bank-transfer screen. Apart from your PIN, please tell me what you are unsure about.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 講習の受講料を振り込みたいのですが、画面の受取人名が案内に書かれた名前と違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受講料を振り込む際に画面の受取人名が案内と違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to transfer a course fee, but the recipient name on the screen is different from the name in the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the recipient name on the screen differs from the instructions when paying a course fee. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ確定していなければ、そのまま進めずに情報を照合しましょう。銀行名、支店名、口座番号は案内と一致していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you have not confirmed it yet, do not continue; let us check the details. Do the bank name, branch, and account number match the instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 口座番号を一桁入力し間違えていました。正しく直せば、すぐ確定してもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 口座番号一桁を誤入力し訂正すればすぐ確定してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I entered one digit of the account number incorrectly. Once I correct it, is it all right to confirm immediately?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you mistyped one account-number digit and ask whether you can confirm immediately after correcting it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入力を直した後も、表示される受取人名を必ず確かめてください。案内と一致しない場合は、振込を依頼した相手に情報をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even after correcting the entry, be sure to check the displayed recipient name. If it does not match the instructions, confirm the details with the party requesting the transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 直したら名義は一致しました。でも金額に振込手数料を足して送るのか、案内を読んでもわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 訂正後に名義が一致したが金額に手数料を足して送るか不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: After correcting it, the account name matches. But even after reading the instructions, I cannot tell whether I should add the transfer fee to the amount I send.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the name matches after correction but you do not know whether to add the fee to the amount sent. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 振込金額と銀行の手数料は別に確認しましょう。相手に送るべき金額は依頼元へ、こちらの手数料は確認画面でお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the transfer amount and the bank's fee separately. Check the amount to send with the requesting party, and our fee on the confirmation screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いったん画面を戻して、講習の窓口に電話します。手数料の意味を取り違えて、多く送ってしまうところでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 画面を戻し講習窓口に電話し手数料誤解で過剰送金しかけたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will go back on the screen and phone the course office. I nearly sent too much by misunderstanding what the fee meant.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will go back and phone the course office, and nearly sent too much because of misunderstanding the fee. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最終確認の前であれば、今日は実行せずにお帰りいただけます。回答があってから、あらためて手続きなさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you have not reached final confirmation, you can leave without making the transfer today. Please start the procedure again after you have the answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は振り込まずに確認します。次は口座名義、送る金額、手数料をそれぞれ確かめてから実行します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は振り込まず次回は名義、送金額、手数料を別々に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check without transferring today. Next time, I will verify the account name, amount to send, and fee separately before proceeding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not transfer today and next time will separately verify the name, transfer amount, and fee. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確定前の確認が大切です。画面を終了して、お持ちの案内もお忘れなく。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: It is important to check before confirming. Please close the screen and do not forget your instructions. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 合計を出す前に、袋は何枚お付けしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before I total your shopping, how many bags would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袋は二つ持っています。冷たい魚のパックと、紙の箱の商品を別々に入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袋を二つ持参し冷たい魚パックと紙箱の商品を分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have brought two bags. I want to put the chilled fish pack and the item in a paper box in separate bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you brought two bags and want to separate the chilled fish pack from the item in a paper box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 魚のパックは水滴が付いていますね。ほかの商品と分けておきます。お支払いはどの方法になさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are water droplets on the fish pack. I will keep it apart from the other items. How would you like to pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電子マネーを使いたいです。ただ、残高が足りるかはまだ見ていません。合計はいくらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残高は未確認だが電子マネーを使いたく合計を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to use electronic money, but I have not checked whether the balance is enough. What is the total?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to use electronic money but have not checked the balance, and ask the total. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お買い上げは二千二百円です。決済する前に、お手元で残高をお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Your total is two thousand two hundred yen. Please check your balance on your side before payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 千八百円しかありませんでした。今日は現金で払いたいので、まだ電子マネーを読み取らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残高千八百円で現金に変え読み取りはまだしないよう依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I only have one thousand eight hundred yen. I would like to pay cash today, so please do not scan the electronic money yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the balance of eighteen hundred yen, change to cash, and ask them not to scan the electronic money yet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。現金のお支払いへ切り替えます。お預かりするのは、こちらの五千円札でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. I will switch to cash payment. This five-thousand-yen note is the amount you are handing over, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、五千円です。おつりとレシートを受け取ってから、自分で袋に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 五千円札と確認しつりとレシート受領後に自分で袋詰めすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, five thousand yen. After receiving the change and receipt, I will pack the shopping myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the five-thousand-yen note and say you will pack your own bags after receiving the change and receipt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二千八百円のお返しです。レシートもどうぞ。魚のパックは、こちらに分けてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is two thousand eight hundred yen change, and your receipt. I have set the fish pack apart here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: おつりを確認しました。魚は保冷の袋、箱の商品は乾いた袋に入れて、まっすぐ帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: つりを確認し魚は保冷袋、紙箱は乾いた袋に入れ直接帰宅すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the change. I will put the fish in the insulated bag and the boxed item in the dry bag, then go straight home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you checked the change, will put the fish in an insulated bag and the paper box in a dry bag, and go straight home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お持ちの袋も商品も、お忘れ物がないかご確認ください。お買い上げありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check that you have all your bags and shopping. Thank you for your purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 日が落ち始めましたね。これから園内を歩かれる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: The sun is beginning to set. Are you planning to walk in the park now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 待ち合わせまで少し時間があるので、二十分くらい散歩したいです。暗くなると道がわからなくなりそうで心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 待ち合わせまで二十分散歩したいが暗くなると道が不明になりそうで心配だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a little time before meeting someone, so I would like a walk of around twenty minutes. I am worried I might lose my way when it gets dark.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want a twenty-minute walk before meeting someone but worry about losing your way in the dark. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 奥の道まで進まず、入口近くで戻れる範囲を考えましょう。お待ち合わせも、この入口でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Rather than going to the paths farther in, let us consider a range near the entrance that you can return from. Are you meeting at this entrance too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、入口の時計の下です。散歩中に連絡が来たら、すぐそこへ戻れるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口の時計下で待ち合わせ連絡が来たらすぐ戻りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, under the clock at the entrance. I want to be able to return there immediately if I am contacted during my walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you are meeting under the entrance clock and want to return immediately if contacted. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この案内図で入口沿いの道とベンチの印を確認できます。照明がある印はありますが、今すべて点いているかは確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: This map shows the path along the entrance and the bench symbols. There are lighting symbols, but I have not checked whether all the lights are on now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 実際に明るさを見て、暗い部分には入りません。途中で座って待てるベンチも、入口から近いものを選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 明るさを見て暗い所に入らず入口近くのベンチを選びたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will check how bright it actually is and not enter dark areas. I would also like a bench close to the entrance where I can sit and wait along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check the light, avoid dark areas, and choose a bench near the entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この印の位置を目安にしてください。ベンチが使えなければ、入口へ戻って待つ方法もあります。時計の見える位置を覚えておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Use these symbols as a guide. If you cannot use a bench, you can return and wait at the entrance. Remember a position where you can see the clock.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 時計が見えなくなるほど離れないようにします。帰る道が不安になったら、その場から知らない道へ進まず戻ればよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時計の見える範囲に留まり不安時は知らない道へ進まず戻ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will stay close enough to see the clock. If I feel unsure about the way back, I should turn back instead of continuing along an unfamiliar path, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm you will remain within sight of the clock and return rather than take an unfamiliar path if unsure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。明るいうちに来た道を戻ってください。戻る方向がわからなくなったら、無理に進まず案内できる職員へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Retrace your route while it is still light. If you no longer know which direction to return in, do not keep going; ask a staff member who can guide you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 短く往復して、ベンチが空いていなければ入口で待ちます。散歩の長さより待ち合わせを優先します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 短い往復でベンチが空いていなければ入口で待ち待ち合わせを優先すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take a short walk out and back, and if no bench is free, wait at the entrance. I will prioritize meeting the person over the length of my walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will make a short return walk, wait at the entrance if no bench is free, and prioritize the meeting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 足元と時間を確認しながらお歩きください。お待ち合わせの方と会えますように。それでは、気をつけてどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please watch your footing and the time while walking. I hope you meet up successfully. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運行案内をご覧になっていましたね。お乗りになる予定の列車はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were looking at the service information. Which train are you planning to take?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 次の列車で出勤する予定です。表示に遅れとありますが、何時に来るかはまだわからないのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 次の列車で出勤予定で到着時刻が未定か尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am planning to take the next train to work. The display says it is delayed; is its arrival time still unknown?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you plan to take the next train to work and ask whether its arrival time is still undecided. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在の案内には確定した到着時刻が出ていません。新しい情報が入りましたら表示と放送をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The current information does not give a confirmed arrival time. Please check the display and announcements when new information comes in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 職場へ連絡したいのですが、何分遅れると伝えればいいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 何分遅れると伝えるべきか迷っていると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to contact my workplace, but I am unsure how many minutes late to tell them I will be.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you are unsure how many minutes of delay to report. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今は到着時刻が未定という状況を伝え、見通しがわかってから改めて連絡する方法があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You could explain that the arrival time is currently unknown and contact them again once there is a clearer estimate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まず遅延で出勤が遅れる可能性を伝えます。運転自体が取りやめになったわけではないのですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 遅刻の可能性を知らせ遅延と運休を区別したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: First I will tell them I may be late because of the delay. The service itself has not been cancelled, has it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will report the possibility of being late and want to distinguish a delay from a cancellation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この表示は遅延のお知らせですが、今後の変更は最新案内で確かめてください。列車を待つか別の移動方法にするかも判断が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: This display announces a delay, but please check the latest information for any further changes. You also need to decide whether to wait for the train or use another way to travel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ほかの方法はまだ調べていません。いったん職場へ電話して、ここで次の案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他の交通手段は未調査で先に職場へ電話し案内を待つ。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not looked into other options yet. I will phone work first and wait here for the next update.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have not checked other transport options and will first phone work and wait for information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 電話は通行の妨げにならない場所でお願いします。放送が聞こえなかった場合は、お戻りになって確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please make your call where you will not obstruct people passing. If you cannot hear an announcement, come back and check with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 端の空いている場所で電話します。連絡を済ませてから表示を見直し、わからなければまた尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 空いている場所で電話し表示を再確認、不明なら尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will call from the empty space at the side. Afterward I will check the display again and ask if anything is unclear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will call in a clear space, check the display again, and ask if unsure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確定していない時刻を無理に伝えなくてもよいと思います。それでは、足元と周りに気をつけてご連絡ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I do not think you need to give an unconfirmed time. Please watch your footing and surroundings while making contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 暮らしの相談でしょうか。差し支えない範囲で内容を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this a question about daily living? Please tell me as much as you feel comfortable sharing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: アパートの騒音で困っています。ただ、ここでは周りに人がいるので、詳しい住所や事情は話したくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 騒音で困り周囲のいる窓口で詳しい事情を話したくないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am having trouble with noise in my apartment. But there are people around here, so I do not want to discuss my exact address or the details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say noise is troubling you and you do not want to discuss details at a counter with others nearby. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここで詳しくお話しにならなくて結構です。個別に話せる相談先と、予約の要否を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You do not need to explain the details here. Let us find a service where you can speak privately and check whether an appointment is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 管理会社には一度連絡しましたが、まだ改善していません。その経緯も相談できる場所を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 管理会社へ連絡済みで改善せず経緯も相談したいと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I contacted the management company once, but it has not improved yet. I would like to know somewhere I can also discuss that history.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you contacted management but nothing has improved, and want to discuss that history too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 住まいの相談として担当へ確認します。連絡した日や返答を、覚えている範囲で整理しておくと説明しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check with the housing-advice staff. It will be easier to explain if you note the dates you contacted management and their replies as far as you remember.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: メールのやり取りが残っています。予約のときに全部送るのか、当日見せるのかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保存メールを予約時に送るか当日示すか尋ねたいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I still have the email exchange. I would also like to check whether I should send all of it when booking or show it on the day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to ask whether to send the saved emails when booking or show them on the day. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 資料の扱いは相談先の案内に従ってください。まず予約方法と、当日必要な物を確認してお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please follow that service's guidance on handling materials. First I will check how to book and what you need on the day, then tell you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相談の内容を家族に聞かれたくないので、私の携帯電話に連絡してもらえるか尋ねたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族に聞かれないよう本人の携帯への連絡を希望する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not want my family to hear about the consultation, so I would like to ask whether they can contact me on my own mobile.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request contact on your own mobile so your family does not hear the consultation details. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その希望も担当へ伝えます。予約を取る際には、連絡が取れる時間帯もお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass that preference on too. When booking, also tell them the times when you can be reached.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昼休みなら電話に出られます。相談先がわかったら、自分で予約して資料の持参方法も聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 昼休みに応答でき自分で予約し資料の持参方法を確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can answer during my lunch break. Once I know the service, I will book it myself and ask how to bring the materials.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you can answer during lunch, will book yourself, and check how to bring the materials. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご希望を添えて相談先を確認します。詳しい事情は個別の相談でお話しください。それでは、案内をお渡しするまでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will find the service and include your preferences. Please discuss the details privately there. Wait here until I give you the information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会計はお済みですね。受け取った書類について何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have finished paying. Is there a problem with the documents you received?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 領収書と明細書をもらいました。会社に「受診したことがわかる書類」を出すよう言われたのですが、どちらを出せばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 領収書と明細書があり受診を証明する提出書類を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received a receipt and an itemized statement. My company told me to submit a document showing I had a medical visit. Which should I submit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have a receipt and itemized statement, and ask which document to submit to prove the visit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 職場が何を必要としているかで異なります。病名や休む期間がわかる書類まで求められていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: It depends on what your workplace requires. Do they also want a document showing the diagnosis or how long you need off work?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そこまでは言われていません。今日病院へ来たことだけを確認したいのかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 病名や休業期間の指定はなく来院のみ必要か不明と説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: They have not specified that much. They may only want to confirm that I came to the hospital today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that no diagnosis or period off work was specified, and it is unclear whether only the visit needs proving. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず職場に書類名や必要な記載を確認するとよいですね。発行の手続きや料金については、受付の担当にお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would be best to check the document name and required information with work first. Ask the reception staff about issuance procedures and charges.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 病名は必要でなければ伝えたくありません。会社には、何を証明すればよいか聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不要な病名は伝えず職場へ証明すべき内容を確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not want to disclose the diagnosis if it is unnecessary. I will ask the company what exactly I need to prove.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will avoid disclosing an unnecessary diagnosis and check with work what needs proving. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご希望も併せて伝えてください。書類の種類がわかったら、こちらの受付で発行できるか相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell them that preference as well. Once you know the document type, ask this reception whether we can issue it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 診断書が必要と言われた場合も、ここで今日すぐにもらえるとは限らないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診断書も当日即時にもらえるとは限らないと確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even if they say a medical certificate is necessary, I cannot necessarily receive it here immediately today, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that even a medical certificate is not necessarily available immediately on the same day. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、医師による確認や発行にかかる日数などがあります。私は今ここで発行日を決めることはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is right. There may be a doctor's check and time needed for issuance. I cannot decide the issue date here right now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日の領収書はなくさないよう保管します。会社への確認が済んでから、受付で費用と日数を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 領収書を保管し職場確認後に受付へ費用と日数を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep today's receipt safely. After checking with my company, I will ask reception about the cost and number of days.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the receipt and ask reception the cost and days after checking with work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 書類を種類ごとに保管しておくと取り出しやすいですよ。それでは、職場の指定をご確認のうえ受付にご相談ください。受診後ですので、帰りも無理をせずお大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Keeping the documents sorted by type makes them easy to find. Please check your workplace's requirements and then consult reception. You have just had a medical visit, so do not overexert yourself on the way home. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくされた物について伺います。どんな物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let me ask about the item you lost. What sort of item is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さい楽器のケースです。黒い硬いケースで、取っ手に赤いひもを結んであります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 黒い硬い楽器ケースで赤いひもの目印があると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a small musical-instrument case. A hard black case with a red cord tied around the handle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe a hard black instrument case marked with a red cord. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ケースの中身と、ほかにも見分けられる特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What is inside, and are there any other distinguishing features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 中はハーモニカ二本です。ふたに丸い傷があり、鍵をかけています。鍵は私が持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ハーモニカ二本、丸い傷、施錠済みで鍵は本人所持と伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are two harmonicas inside. There is a round scratch on the lid, and it is locked. I have the key.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it contains two harmonicas, has a round scratch, is locked, and you hold the key. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後にケースを持っていたと確かめられるのは、いつ、どこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: When and where can you last be sure you had the case?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日の昼、公園のベンチに座ったときはありました。帰り道で気づいたので、落とした場所は断定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昼の公園ベンチでは所持し帰り道で気づき場所未確定と伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I had it when I sat on a park bench at lunchtime today. I noticed on the way home, so I cannot say for certain where I lost it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you had it on a park bench at noon and noticed it missing on the way home, so the loss location is uncertain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最後に見た場所と、紛失に気づいた場所を分けて記録します。ベンチに戻って探しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record the last place you saw it separately from where you noticed the loss. Did you return to the bench and search?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 戻りましたが見つかりませんでした。公園の管理窓口にも聞いたところ、今のところ届いていないと言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ベンチへ戻り管理窓口にも聞いたが見つからないと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I returned but could not find it. I also asked the park management counter, and they said none had been handed in so far.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you returned to the bench and asked park management but could not find it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その確認状況も伺って届け出の内容を整理します。見つかった場合に連絡できる電話番号を記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will include those checks when organizing the report. Please write a telephone number where we can contact you if it is found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この携帯番号を書きます。もし自分で見つけたら、こちらにも知らせたほうがいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 携帯番号を記入し自己発見時は警察へ知らせると確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write this mobile number. If I find it myself, I should let you know here too, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Write your mobile number and confirm you should notify the police if you find it yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 見つかった場合は届け出についてご連絡ください。ご自分で探すときも、立入禁止の場所には入らないようお願いします。それでは、ケースを探す途中も周囲に気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please contact us about your report if you find it. When searching yourself, do not enter areas marked off-limits. Take care of your surroundings as you search for the case and head home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票をお持ちですね。お荷物の受け取りについてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have brought a missed-delivery notice. Is this about collecting your parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の近くなのでここへ来ました。この紙を出せば、今日ここで荷物を受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 近い窓口へ来て当日ここで受取可能か尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came here because it is close to home. If I show this paper, can I collect my parcel here today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you came to a nearby counter and ask whether you can collect here today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず不在票に書かれた保管先を確認します。近くの窓口に来ただけでは、ここに荷物があるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: First I will check the storage location written on the notice. Coming to a nearby counter does not necessarily mean your parcel is here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: よく見ると別の郵便局名が書いてあります。行き直す前に、受け取れる場所を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別郵便局名に気づき移動前に受取場所を確認したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Looking closely, it has a different post office's name. Before going elsewhere, I want to confirm where I can collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you noticed a different post office's name and want to check the collection location before travelling. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記載の問い合わせ先で保管状況を確認してください。窓口受け取りと再配達のどちらをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the storage status using the contact details on the notice. Would you prefer counter collection or redelivery?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今週は帰宅時間が毎日違うので、窓口で受け取れたら助かります。予約や事前連絡は必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰宅時刻不定で窓口希望、事前連絡や予約の要否を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: My time getting home varies every day this week, so counter collection would help. Is a reservation or advance contact needed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your arrival home varies, prefer counter collection, and ask whether advance contact or booking is needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 荷物の種類と受け取り先によるため、案内を確認しましょう。本人確認書類など、持参する物も併せて聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: It depends on the parcel type and collection office, so let us check the guidance. Please also ask what to bring, such as identification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本人が行くつもりです。不在票と確認書類を用意して、受付時間も調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人が不在票と確認書類を用意し受付時間を調べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I plan to go myself. I will prepare the notice and identification, and check the opening hours too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will go yourself with the notice and identification and check the counter hours. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保管期限の記載も見落とさないでください。期限に間に合うか不安な場合は、先に問い合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do not overlook the storage deadline either. If you are worried about making it in time, contact them beforehand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 期限を見て、書かれた連絡先へ電話します。保管先と受け取り方を確認してから出かけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保管期限を読み記載先へ電話し確認後に出かける。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the deadline and phone the contact listed. I will go only after confirming the storage location and how to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will read the storage deadline, phone the listed contact, and go after checking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認せずに別の窓口へ向かう手間を避けられますね。それでは、不在票をお忘れなくお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: That saves you an unnecessary trip to another counter without checking. Please remember to take your notice home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードが見当たらないとのことですね。どの種類のカードをお使いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your card is missing, I understand. What type of card do you use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらの銀行のキャッシュカードです。家を探してもなく、昨日の引き出しのあとから見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 当銀行キャッシュカードで昨日の出金後から見ていないと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is this bank's cash card. I searched at home without finding it, and have not seen it since yesterday's withdrawal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say it is this bank's cash card and you have not seen it since withdrawing money yesterday. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず本人確認を行い、利用停止の手続きをご案内します。カード以外の本人確認書類はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: First we will verify your identity and explain how to block it. Do you have identification other than the card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 運転免許証を持っています。カードが家にあるかもしれなくても、先に止める相談をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 免許証があり家の紛失可能性でも先に停止相談したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my driving licence. Even if the card might be at home, I would like to discuss blocking it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have a licence and want to discuss blocking first even if it may be lost at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 紛失としての手続きを確認しましょう。最後に利用した日時と、その後に気づいたことを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the lost-card procedure. Please tell me when you last used it and anything you noticed afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方に使いました。今朝、現金を出そうとして財布にないことに気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨日夕方に使い今朝財布にないと気づいたと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I used it yesterday evening. This morning, when I went to get some cash, I noticed it was not in my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you used it yesterday evening and noticed this morning that it was not in your wallet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その経緯を記録します。利用状況で覚えのない取引がないかも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record that sequence. Let us also check the usage history for any transactions you do not recognize.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日の出金額は覚えています。知らない取引があれば、私の利用ではないことを伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 昨日の出金額は覚えており身に覚えのない取引は申告したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I remember how much I withdrew yesterday. If there are unfamiliar transactions, I want to say that I did not make them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you remember yesterday's withdrawal amount and want to report transactions you do not recognize. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認しながら伺います。停止後にカードが見つかっても、自己判断で使わず銀行に連絡してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will ask while checking. If the card is found after blocking, do not use it on your own judgment; contact the bank.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見つかったときも連絡します。再発行が必要か、費用や受け取りまでの期間は手続きの説明で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見時も連絡し再発行要否、費用、受取期間を確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will contact you if I find it. During the procedure explanation, I will check whether a replacement is needed, its cost, and how long until I receive it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will contact them if found and check replacement necessity, cost, and receipt time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 利用停止と、その後の手続きを順番にご案内します。それでは、免許証をお手元にご用意のうえ、この席でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will explain blocking and the subsequent procedures in order. Please have your licence ready and wait in this seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品についてのご相談ですね。どのような状態だったか教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a question about a product. Could you tell me what condition it was in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った保存容器です。家で包装越しに見ると、底にひびが入っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日購入した保存容器の底に包装越しにひびを発見したと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a food-storage container I bought yesterday. Looking through the packaging at home, I saw a crack in the bottom.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you found a crack through the packaging in the bottom of yesterday's food-storage container. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 包装はまだ開けていない状態ですね。使用されたり、中に食品を入れたりはしていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the packaging is still unopened. Have you used it or put any food inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 使っていません。包装もそのままです。ひびを見つけた時点の写真も撮りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未使用未開封で発見時の写真があると説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not used it. The packaging is untouched too. I also took a photo when I found the crack.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is unused and unopened, and you have a photo from when you discovered the crack. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 状態を確認させてください。購入日時がわかるレシートなどはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please let us check its condition. Do you have a receipt or something showing the purchase date and time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このレシートです。容器を二つ買ったうち、片方だけにひびがありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: レシートを提示し二つ中片方の不具合と説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is the receipt. I bought two containers, and only one of them had a crack.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the receipt and explain that one of the two containers has the defect. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対象の商品とレシートを照合して、対応方法を担当に確認します。交換をご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will match the affected product with the receipt and ask the person in charge how to handle it. Would you like an exchange?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 傷のない同じ物があれば交換したいです。在庫がない場合は、別の対応ができるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じ物との交換希望で在庫なし時は他の対応を確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: If you have the same item without damage, I would like to exchange it. If it is out of stock, I want to know whether another response is possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request an exchange for the same item and ask about other options if there is no stock. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 在庫と対応条件を確認してからご説明します。確認前に同じ棚の商品を開けて調べることはお控えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain after checking stock and the conditions. Before that check, please refrain from opening products on the same shelf to inspect them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 店員さんの確認を待ちます。交換になった場合は、持ち帰る前に一緒に状態を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 店員の判断を待ち交換品は持帰り前に一緒に確認したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait for the staff's check. If it is exchanged, could you check the condition with me before I take it home?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait for the staff's decision and want to inspect a replacement together before taking it home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 対応が決まりましたら商品の確認もご相談ください。それでは、容器とレシートをお預かりして担当に確認してきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once the response is decided, please also discuss checking the product. I will take the container and receipt and go to ask the person in charge.
